baselineDisplay.title: Is That All
baselineDisplay.question: Does the lady buy any chalk?
baselineDisplay.text:
Does the lady buy any chalk?

I want some envelopes, please.
Do you want the large size or the small size?
The large size, please.
Do you have any writing paper?
Yes, we do.
I don't have any small pads.
I only have large ones.
Do you want a pad?
Yes, please.
And I want some glue.
A bottle of glue.
And I want a large box of chalk, too.
I only have small boxes.
Do you want one?
No, thank you.
Is that all?
That's all, thank you.
What else do you want?
I want my change.

baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
请给我一些信封。
您想要大号的还是小号的？
请给我大号的。
你们有写字用的纸吗？
是的，我们有。
我没有小本的信纸。
我只有大本的。
您需要一本吗？
好的，请给我一本。
我还需要一些胶水。
一瓶胶水。
我还要一大盒粉笔。
我只有小盒的。
您要一盒吗？
不，谢谢。
就这些吗？
就这些，谢谢。
你还想要什么？
我想要我的零钱。
